sub: Kay Rand Morgan · Section W01 · Kennesaw State University
All terminal output is a real recorded run; long steps are sped up as marked.

title: The raw data
caption: Seven OULAD CSV files: 10,655,280 clickstream rows plus registrations, assessments, courses and the VLE catalog.

title: Warehouse design
caption: Target design: a fact constellation. Weekly clicks and assessment submissions share six conformed dimensions; two aggregates roll up the clicks.

title: One-command rebuild
caption: build_warehouse.py drops and rebuilds everything: staging, 17 timed SQL steps, then the reconciliation suite.
final_caption: 28 of 28 checks pass: every row and all 39,605,099 clicks reach the fact table and both aggregates.

title: Inside the warehouse
caption: One student’s weeks 1–4: one row per week and activity type. A week with no clicks becomes a “(no activity)” row instead of a gap.

title: OLAP query pack
caption: 11 OLAP queries, each timed five times. Where an aggregate can answer, the harness checks it returns identical rows.
final_caption: Aggregates return identical rows up to 688× faster; the gain tracks how much each aggregate shrinks the scan.

title: OLAP query pack
caption: Cross-tab Q06: in the lowest week-1–4 click decile 97% fail or withdraw; in the top decile, 25%.

title: OLAP query pack
caption: Weekly clicks per enrolled student from the aggregate: early peaks, then taper. Modules differ about 3× in intensity.

title: No-leakage check
caption: The feature view may only see days 0–27. This script recomputes every feature from the raw CSV to prove it.
final_caption: 0 mismatches with the day-28 cutoff; 25,679 without it (the negative control). LEAKAGE CHECK PASS.

title: Early-alert models
caption: Logistic regression, CART and naive Bayes: 5-fold CV, then train on February presentations and test on October.
final_caption: Logistic regression wins: held-out AUC 0.719, 8.1 points over the baseline; tuned threshold catches 80% of at-risk students.

title: Early-alert models
caption: Held-out October test: ROC, precision–recall with tuned operating points, and lift. The top risk decile is 80% at risk.

title: Engagement archetypes
caption: k-means for k = 2…10, checked against Ward clustering; k = 4 chosen at the elbow (Ward agreement ARI 0.64).

title: Engagement archetypes
caption: Four archetypes: Minimal (65% fail or withdraw), Steady/forum, Assessment-spike (most withdrawals) and Broad (29%).

title: Fairness audit
caption: Protected attributes are joined only after prediction. Passes the four-fifths screen for gender, IMD and disability; fails for age band (0.60).

title: Text-to-SQL
caption: Qwen2.5-Coder-7B wrote this SQL from the warehouse-generated schema (recorded run, re-executed live): correct, and it used the aggregate.

title: Text-to-SQL
caption: A typical miss: week_key = 2 treats a surrogate key as a week number, and a composite code goes in the wrong column.

title: Text-to-SQL
caption: Scored on the 40 held-out questions: 19/40 exact matches (47.5%), aggregates chosen for 91% of eligible questions. No schema: 0/40.
